about_the_game:
"Neonpixel – Anime Tree of Life Set" is a versatile tileset collection designed to bring a variety of imaginative scenes to life such as small islands that remain as the final safe havens in a flooded world, or rocky outcrops sheltering the last tree as a symbol of hope. Create partially submerged villages or vibrant life among the treetops with this pack!

·   All assets are handcrafted with pixel-perfect passion.

·   Enhance your scenes with animated elements such as lifts, fog effects, and interactive buttons.

·   Ideal for beginners in map design! This asset pack is built with usability in mind, making it easy and enjoyable to create beautiful maps.

 Contents:

【tilesets (26 sheets)】

・A1 tiles：4 sheets (Day and Night)

・B~C~D~E~ tiles：22 sheets (Day and Night)

 【animation (5 sheets)】

・Fog 154×158pixel (3 pattern)

・Lift_a 48×96pixel (4 pattern)

・Lift_b 48×96pixel (4 pattern)

・Light  48×96pixel (4 pattern)

・Lift Button  48×96pixel (8 pattern)

Includes sample map (project data)

---------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
